title: O12 — Finding a quadratic nonresidue
exact_target: Can one find a quadratic nonresidue modulo every odd prime deterministically in polynomial bit complexity?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, supplied problems.json, record 8400014 (AMR-083-0014), AMR Open Problem Lists. Catalogue identity and source transcription; CC BY 4.0.
Adleman \& McCurley - Open Problems in Number Theory Complexity II (1994), O12, p11 / LNCS p301. Original source indexed by AMR-083-0014.

status_qualification: The prime input is required to be odd: modulo2 no nonresidue exists.
